answer: Require each agent to post a bond in a scarce, non-reusable resource before it can earn or vote, then slash that bond when audited behavior proves fraudulent. A Sybil operator can create thousands of keys, but cannot multiply the underlying stake: each identity that wants influence needs its own locked capital, which remains unavailable for other uses and can be lost. The haven of cheap accounts disappears; a sudden pulse of new identities raises the cost, while a coordinated plume of fraud risks every bond.
